'''Tuloo''' was a [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Myykian]] [[youngling]] who lived on [[At Attin]] in the [[New Republic Era]]. Their family consisted of a [[Nooma|mother]], [[Nol|father]], a brother [[Neel]], twin brothers [[Jobo]] and [[Jorko]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

After missing their [[Career Assessment Test]] the [[human]] [[Wim]] came to [[Neel's home|Tuloo's home]] looking for Neel. When asked where he was through the window Tuloo pointed up, indicating that Neel was upstairs.<ref name="Real Adventure" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tuloo first appeared in the first episode of [[2024]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]".
